name: kinetic-morph-text
title: Kinetic Morph Text
description: Letters lift, rotate, and reshape into the next phrase with delicate outline trails.
useWhen: A short sequence of phrases should feel like the same letters physically rearranging.
A playful title needs individual letter flights, soft shape changes and readable pauses.
avoidWhen: Words should switch with minimal movement: use per-word-crossfade.
The text should stay readable throughout a subtle entrance: use per-character-rise.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Text
variables.description: One phrase per line, or separate phrases with |.
variables.default: Hello | Make it move | Shape what's next

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Maximum type size in pixels. Long phrases shrink to fit 82 % of the width.

variables.label: Background
variables.description: Color of the field behind the letters.

variables.label: Spread
variables.description: Flight radius of the letters in pixels.

variables.label: Morph
variables.description: Strength of the soft silhouette blend, 0 to 1.

variables.label: Trails
variables.description: Opacity of the outline echoes, 0 to 1.

variables.label: Transition frames
variables.description: Frames each phrase change takes (30 fps).

variables.label: Hold frames
variables.description: Frames each phrase rests before the next change.

variables.label: Loop
variables.description: Return to the first phrase at the end instead of resting on the last.
